content.title: Tennant (NYSE:TNC) Misses Q3 Sales Expectations
content.summary: Industrial cleaning equipment manufacturer Tennant Company missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 4% year on year to $303.3 million. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $1.23 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.46 per share was 2.9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
